data.action: 一手拿巨型棉花糖、另一手牵同伴沿祭典街前行，爱心尾巴欢快摇摆
data.camera: medium shot, eye-level, joyful festive atmosphere
data.description: 红灯笼下的祭典长街上，菈菈左手牵着并肩的梨斗，右手举着巨大的棉花糖。暖橙灯火映着她的笑脸，爱心尾巴在身后欢快摇摆。
data.lighting: 漫天红灯笼洒下的浓郁暖橙火光与摊位彩灯的缤纷倒影
data.location: 彩南町夏日祭典红灯笼小吃长街
data.promptProse: Lala walks past the stalls with a giant cotton candy in her right hand, her long pink hair and heart-tipped tail moving behind her. Short brown-haired Rito, wearing an indigo festival jacket, walks at her left and holds her free hand. A row of red lanterns warms both faces.
data.title: 菈菈 · 夏夜祭典的云朵棉花糖
data.animaCaption: Lala walks with her long pink hair and heart-tipped tail trailing, holding the cotton candy in her right hand. Her left hand clasps Rito's. He has short spiky brown hair and a dark indigo festival jacket.
